name: Utsugi Sen'ya
source:
"I'm... useless?"

The younger brother of the producer "Ichiya". He is taciturn and poor at expressing his emotions, but his parents are musicians, and his singing and dancing skills are both superior to the other candidates.

His older brother, Ichiya, forced him to enroll in a music school, saying, "It would be a waste to let his talent be buried."

Hobby: Reading
Favorite Food: Nothing special
Dislikes: Sweets

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20040207000607/http://www.will-game.com/BCM/gb01/char01.htm]official website[/url]]
